meta.title: Thread network
meta.question: Which questions are linked, and how do the links cross the gates?
caveats: Links are defined by the instrument (P1 linkage inventory), not computed from answers.
Breakout, grouping and same-respondent links describe structure, not content; the view shows them on request.
Statistical links between threads (T07) are group-level — the ecological caveat applies.
meta.provenance: Links RECON_DATA or INFERRED per edge (provenance field).

nodes.wording: What qualities make a vendor a strategic, value-added provider?
Does your firm generally spend more money with strategic providers than with other vendors?
How likely are you to respond to each method of being contacted by a vendor sales person?
How often do you initiate a meeting after the following types of referrals?
In your best estimate, what percentage of the requests to meet with you are screened out by a staff member or administrative staff member?
In a typical week, how many vendor sales person appointments do you accept?
For what reasons do you to take an appointment?
When you meet with a vendor sales person, in general how often are they prepared for the meeting with you in the following ways?
How often would you say that your meetings with sales people are valuable and live up to your expectations of the meeting?
Only thinking about your initial meeting with a vendor sales person, in general how often do you accept follow-on meetings?
What would you consider a valuable meeting with a vendor sales person?

During a long and complex sales cycle, vendors often provide you with a variety of materials, such as collateral, case studies, data sheets, and ROI calculators, to futher inform you. Considering the material...
How important and differentiating are the following for a meeting with a vendor sales person?

Thinking of a typical meeting with a vendor sales team (or person), how would you characterize their agenda in your interactions? Please pick the one that best matches your opinion of the majority of sales calls you participate in.
Think of a situation where you were initially interested in what a vendor was talking to you about, but you changed your mind and did not make a purchase. What were some of the reasons why...
How often do you choose a vendor who has worked with you to turn a vision into a clear path to value?
Which of the following best describes the process of developing a business case to justify investment for you/your organization?
Considering the materials that vendors typically provide you with, which of the following best describe how well those materials helps you develop convincing reasons to invest?
How important are the following attributes for shaping a vision into a clear program plan?
Do you have a purchase limit? If so, what is it?
What most differentiates a vendor/supplier from their competition?
Thinking about all of your vendors/suppliers, which 3 companies have sales teams you find <u>MOST</u> effective and please share your thoughts on why.
Thinking about all of your vendors/suppliers, which 3 companies have sales teams you find <u>LEAST</u> effective and please share your thoughts on why.
Thinking about your BEST vendor/supplier relationships, who is your primary point of contact – for example, account manager, consultant, product specialist, or executive - and why?
Thinking about your WORST vendor/supplier relationships, who is your primary point of contact – for example, account manager, consultant, product specialist, or executive - and why?
Which of the following departments do you work in?
Which of the following most closely describes your position?
Which title best describes your position at your organization?
Which of the following titles best describes your role?
In which of the following stages of 'hS5Piping' decision-making are you currently involved?
We are also interested in your involvement in IT decision-making. In what stages of the IT decision-making process are you involved?
Using your best estimate, in calendar year 2013, what were your companys worldwide revenues?
Using your best estimate, how many employees work for your company worldwide?
In which country is your company headquartered?
How frequently do you engage with a vendor sales person?
To whom does your company sell primarily?
Which of the following best describes your firm’s primary industry?
